Integrator Playbook

Let members redeem points against live merchant supply.

Issue, list and distribute Passes from your loyalty or rewards engine, and keep their status and the member's Vault in sync. Members exchange points against real merchant inventory instead of a catalogue that never changes.

Why reward catalogues stall

Catalogue fatigue

A fixed rewards catalogue that never changes stops driving redemptions. Your redemption rate becomes a function of how stale the list looks.

Codes that fail or double-redeem

Static codes issued from a spreadsheet get screenshotted, shared and reused. Members hit dead codes, and you reconcile the mess later.

No live link to merchant supply

Points sit on your ledger with nothing fresh to spend them on, because adding merchants means a new contract and a new integration each time.

The play

How issuance and redemption work

  1. 1

    List live supply

    Members browse live merchant inventory from the exchange inside your app, not a frozen catalogue.

  2. 2

    Issue a Pass

    A member spends points and you issue a Pass through one API call. It is tokenised, bound to that member, and lands in their Vault.

  3. 3

    Track status

    Issued, held, presented, validated, settled — the Pass status and the member's Vault stay in sync through webhooks.

  4. 4

    Redeem once

    The member presents at a registered outlet or your POS. The Pass is consumed once and reconciled per Pass.

What the integration gives you

Issue with one call

Create, distribute and validate Passes on the same endpoints the marketplace runs on. Idempotency keys stop a retried request issuing twice.

Live merchant supply

Members exchange points against real inventory that refreshes itself, so your redemption rate stops being a function of catalogue fatigue.

Status and Vault in sync

Webhooks for every state change keep your ledger and the member's Vault aligned without polling.

Delivery your way

Deliver by email, SMS, a claim link, or straight into the member's Vault. REST and MCP, sandbox on signup.

// POST /v1/passes   (Idempotency-Key: mbr_44192-2026w41)
{
  "type":        "reward",
  "issuer":      "loy_yourprogramme",
  "member":      "mbr_44192",
  "value":       { "kind": "amount", "amount": 10, "currency": "SGD" },
  "valid_until": "2026-12-31T23:59:59+08:00",
  "deliver":     "vault"
}

// 201 Created
{ "id": "MZF-3F9A-5521", "type": "reward", "status": "held", "holder": "vlt_7c1e…" }

Frequently Asked Questions

Do points leave my system?

No. You keep the loyalty ledger and the member relationship. Mezzofy issues, validates and settles the Pass; points are debited in your engine.

How do I keep status in sync?

Subscribe to webhooks for issued, held, presented, validated and settled events, so your ledger and the member's Vault update without polling.

Can I avoid issuing the same reward twice?

Yes. Send an idempotency key with each issuance; a retried request returns the original Pass rather than minting a new one.

How do members receive a Pass?

By email, SMS, a claim link, or straight into their Vault — whichever fits your app. All on REST or MCP with a sandbox on signup.

Turn points into Passes members actually spend.

Issue against live merchant supply, keep status and the Vault in sync, and settle per Pass — one integration for the whole merchant network.
